  - region "Simple English explanation of Free Point":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Free Point" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A free point in the plane has two independent coordinates. (1,2) can move to (4,−1) without a constraint equation. A point on a circle is not free. A useful rule is Free Point: P=(x,y). You can learn Free Point by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Edit x and y independently and confirm no extra equation binds them. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, sketching: Start a design with movable points. Watch out: Thinking a free point must stay on a line. A free point is independent."

      - generic: Try this example

      - paragraph: A free point is defined by any ordered pair of real numbers.
      - strong: P = (x, y)
      - paragraph: There are no constraints between x and y. Both coordinates can be any real number.
      - heading "Key Facts" [level=3]
      - paragraph: ✓ The point is independent of other objects.
      - paragraph: ✓ It can be moved freely on the plane.
      - paragraph: ✓ Its coordinates update continuously.
